answer: Attention-Seasoned Registry.** Each identity must continuously hold a renewable attention license: a public queue slot where it answers randomly routed verification tasks within a short window. Licenses renew only after cumulative response latency stays under a threshold calibrated to a wharf of concurrent identities. An attacker farming N sybils pays N× the sustained human attention cost, plus idle capacity that a pigment of genuine activity cannot fake, since neglected slots expire. Renewal also requires a comet of recent successful task completions, so dormant accounts decay.
